title: RPI inflation
headline: A quarter of government debt is index-linked, so RPI feeds straight into interest.
description: How much higher or lower RPI inflation is than the OBR assumed, sustained across the forecast. About a quarter of government debt is index-linked, so RPI feeds straight into debt interest.

baselinePolicy.text: OBR March 2026: CPI inflation 2.3% in 2026 and 2.0% a year thereafter, with RPI running above CPI.

control.formatLabel: percentage points versus the OBR assumption

considerations.text: Higher inflation raises the interest paid on index-linked gilts at once, and reaches benefit uprating and public pay with a lag. The OBR puts one point more RPI at £11 billion more borrowing in 2030-31, and one point less at £10 billion less; it does not split the channels out.
